items.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: which I seemed to have heard in later years in Paul Desmond, slightly.

ctx.x: Well, I just liked the sound of the horn, the way he played. He had a sort of a almost a delicate touch to him, which I seemed to have heard in later years in Paul Desmond, slightly. Gee, I don’t know how to explain it. I just don’t know how to explain it. But I liked it. I heard him play Singing the Blues, and I think Old-Fashioned Love and a couple of other things, and I started copying his solos from the record.
It was his sound, I guess. Was it his sound or what he was playing or both?
